final_message: I cleaned the data by removing exact duplicate rows (7 duplicates removed). I kept only one row per order_id to avoid counting re-exports multiple times. I normalized region names by stripping whitespace and capitalizing. I parsed the three date formats and converted all dates to naive UTC datetime for consistent comparison. I excluded orders with missing amounts (-999) from revenue calculations but counted them. Then I calculated the total revenue and order count for the North region in Q1 2024, found the region with the highest total revenue, and counted orders with missing amounts. The results are saved in workspace/answer.json.
